old_problem: Fatal ECRC intent conflicts with Correctable labels; errortype2 is unverified, the copied BDFs do not establish OCP coverage, and no independent-management fatal reset/boot/service recovery branch is approved.
disposition_reason: OCP topology and service bindings can be parameters, but the stimulus and fatal outcome cannot. PCIe standards do not define this vendor flag, and neither ED-03 nor ED-16 permits inferring that errortype2 produces fatal ECRC. Because the only control path may be the OCP interface, a missing independent recovery branch is also a core safety gap. Pending/BLOCKED is retained until vendor and project authority resolve both.

test_case.test_name: OCP fatal ECRC handling and service recovery
test_case.purpose: For every approved OCP module, validate authoritative fatal-ECRC stimuli at endpoint and upstream port through the signed containment/reset branch, durable evidence and restored OCP services.
required_package: Vendor errortype2 definition and corrected severity labels
Independent management and deterministic reset/boot/service outcome matrix
OOB boot/reimage, device/interface recovery and restoration runbook
test_case.test_command: Do not execute the source command. Once vendor semantics and recovery are approved, isolate one OCP path, capture durable OOB/AER/service pre-state, perform one authorized fatal ECRC stimulus at one verified source, record containment/reset and reboot, then restore configuration and prove interface and dependent-service recovery before any other checkpoint.
test_case.expected_result: The intended OCP source reports the signed fatal ECRC event, follows exactly the approved containment/reset path with durable BMC/UEFI/OOB evidence, then returns the driver, link, interface and services to baseline within defined deadlines.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until errortype2 and the fatal branch are authoritative. Correctable output, tool PASS alone, reused PCIe BDFs, wrong source, lost evidence, unexpected reset/no-reset, boot loop, management loss or unrecovered service cannot pass.
safety_gate: Dedicated backed-up SUT with management independent of the tested OCP path.
No execution while severity semantics conflict or critical traffic remains attached.
One source once; abort on wrong target/response, missing durable evidence or boot failure.
No automatic retry/reset; preserve crash evidence before recovery.
expected_evidence: Vendor flag authority and OCP identity/dependency map
test_case.recovery: Must cover both no-reset containment and fatal-reset paths, independent access, boot-loop/reimage escape, OCP driver/interface restoration and exact BIOS/HDT/AER rollback. Execution remains blocked until demonstrated.
